normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands.- 2 adult bikes provided- Centrally located in WaterColor- Screened-in Porch- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Warm neutral tones of taupe and blue provide a relaxing atmosphere in this two-level, multi-family residence with accommodations for six in the Beach District. The primary is privately located on the ground level, and is furnished with a king iron bed and television with DVD. It enjoys access to a screened porch, partially louvered for shade and privacy. The bath contains a large walk-in shower, separate jetted tub and dual vanities. A laundry area including a full-size washer and dryer, plus sink, is also on this level. Upstairs, one light-filled area encompasses living, dining and kitchen - with abundant windows and covered balcony facing Grayton Beach State Park and Western Lake beyond. The sleeper sofa faces an ornate armoire containing television, DVD and stereo. The dining table seats six, with space for two more at the breakfast bar. The open kitchen has honey-toned cabinets, granite countertops and stainless appliances. The bedroom has a queen bed and television. It has a private access to the hall bath, equipped with a walk-in shower and single vanity. Its location on the south side of Town Center makes this residence ultra-convenient to shopping, dining and the Beach Club.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Walk-in Shower, Jetted TubSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Hall Bath With Walk-In ShowerLiving Area: Queen SleeperWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499 acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.

It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Warm neutral tones of taupe and blue provide a relaxing atmosphere in this two-level, multi-family residence with accommodations for six in the Beach District. The primary is privately located on the ground level, and is furnished with a king iron bed and television with DVD. It enjoys access to a screened porch, partially louvered for shade and privacy. Upstairs, one light-filled area encompasses living, dining and kitchen - with abundant windows and covered balcony facing Grayton Beach State Park and Western Lake beyond. The sleeper sofa faces an ornate armoire containing television, DVD and stereo. The dining table seats six, with space for two more at the breakfast bar. The open kitchen has honey-toned cabinets, granite countertops and stainless appliances. The bedroom has a queen bed and television. It has a private access to the hall bath, equipped with a walk-in shower and single vanity. Its location on the south side of Town Center makes this residence ultra-convenient to shopping, dining and the Beach Club.
